business: Claro: filtered water bottle sold online, with replacement filters on subscription
target: US adults, 22 to 45, who carry a reusable bottle most days and buy from social media creators they follow
where: United States, online (Shopify), found through Instagram and TikTok creators

behaviours.name: Creator follower
behaviours.how: Buys things a creator they trust uses on camera, often with their code.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Compares prices, waits for discount codes, hates paying shipping.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Won't buy a new brand without hundreds of reviews and some proof.

behaviours.name: Loyal to a competitor
behaviours.how: Already owns a LARQ, Brita or Stanley and is happy enough with it.

behaviours.name: Subscription-wary
behaviours.how: Has been burned by hard-to-cancel subscriptions and avoids new ones.

behaviours.name: Eco-minded
behaviours.how: Wants to stop buying bottled water and cares about plastic waste.

behaviours.name: Aesthetic buyer
behaviours.how: Buys the bottle that looks good in the gym or on the desk.

objections: I already have a bottle that works
How do I know the filter actually does anything?
Another subscription I'll forget to cancel
Never heard of this brand, it might be a cheap knockoff
My tap water is fine, or I already have a Brita at home
$40-50 is a lot for a water bottle
4-8 day shipping from overseas is slow
habits: you take a bottle to the gym four times a week
you refill at office or campus water fountains
you scroll TikTok or Instagram every evening
you buy a few plastic water bottles a week when you forget yours
you commute about 40 minutes each way
you travel a few times a year and dislike the taste of hotel tap water
